questions.q: Read: "Ben is an archeologist. Every day he has to get up early. He goes to the desert by car. It is very hot, so he has to wear a big hat. He digs slowly and carefully. Today he finds a small gold statue of a cat (statue = bức tượng) in an old tomb." What is Ben's job?
